subject: 天龙山第16窟 · 石刻前廊
author: Patrick20242023
source_note: 2024第16窟实拍。前廊两石柱、莲瓣础与仿木构横梁按照片保留，不补出不存在的瓦屋顶。初始提示词将人字形节奏口述为4，最终核图按实照可见3组主体人字形与交替斗栱。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. One fine-line heritage illustration for 访古. Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER only: delicate sparse slightly organic contours and generous blank white planes. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY only. PURE BLACK INK outlines on PURE WHITE, all interiors white. No gray, no shading, no dark openings, no hatching, no textures, no color, no text, no border. Preserve the real monument, not the Buddha in the style master. Subject: the Northern Qi rock-cut front porch of Tianlongshan Cave 16 in the photograph. Preserve TWO freestanding polygonal stone columns with rounded lotus bases, the horizontal carved beam carrying a rhythm of FOUR inverted-V bracket motifs alternating with small dou brackets, and the simple cave doorway in the rear wall with its damaged lobed arch surround. Keep the actual weathered breaks, do not reconstruct lost stone. Draw a selective frontal study of this porch with a few irregular rock edges fading into white around it. Reduce the low-angle perspective, keep vertical columns straight. Show both entire columns and bases and the full bracket frieze with blank margins. Do NOT add a Chinese tiled roof, no gable, no ridge ornaments, no Buddha, no adjacent caves. Landscape 1536x1024 with structure about 78% width. Only a few cracks and simple outlines; remove graffiti, stone grain, color and deep shadow.

site_recommendation.name: 天龙山石窟
site_recommendation.yearNote: 所绘第16窟前廊属北齐（550—577），560为约略排序点；不套用其他窟的隋唐纪年。
site_recommendation.lede: 两根石柱与柱上的人字形构件，把北齐木构的痕迹留在山岩中。第16窟前廊让天龙山的价值从造像延伸到建筑形制。
facts: 天龙山石窟分东魏、北齐、隋、唐等营造阶段，本图选北齐第16窟。
前廊柱、莲瓣柱础与人字形铺作由岩石雕出，模仿当时的木构形式。
图版保留入口的风化缺损，仅画前廊局部；不补绘流失造像或现代复原像。
